training.protocol: Leave one whole object instance out; 250 fixed full-batch updates; three training seeds; no held-out tuning or early stopping.
training.model_scope: Supervised candidate-outcome heads; no robot-policy training, rollout selection, or demonstrated robustness improvement.
limits: Six source instances in three categories; no scissors coverage.
Pre-intervention full-scene observations; expert nominal target/time-to-close is prototype context.
Existing legacy labels are not relabeled after observing handoff probe outcomes.
Only 15 negative labels; dataset and instances are too small for broad generalization claims.
Candidate-only and full-context heads share architecture/loss/optimizer; only context inputs differ.
All predictions are out of fold, but this is a development pilot, not a final benchmark.

result.limits: Training-source rejection sampling. No per-case controller changes or automatic dataset expansion.
